name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Input/state architecture reset. Use Bangle.setUI custom touch/swipe/button handlers instead of raw listeners, preload widgets at Orbit startup, and speed 5wCal drawing with native bitmap fonts and one-time widget drawing. Calendar selection writes a shared numeric day-offset record immediately; Orbit re-reads that record before every return redraw, so selected dates do not depend on a callback surviving. Successful selection shows SEL MM/DD and buzzes 120 ms. Calendar double-tap window is temporarily 650 ms.
